fact: The World Bank appraisal of the Local Governance and Community Resilience Project (grant of US$90.0 million) plans to extend the SIMBA accounting system to regional treasury directions covering municipalities, with digital payments to the communes, as donor-financed support to the ministries of territorial administration and finance.
title: Project Appraisal Document on a proposed grant to the Central African Republic for a Local Governance and Community Resilience Project
